issues.description: The solution repository implements the animal classes with names SpaceGoat, SpacePig, and SpaceSeal, while the problem statement and UML explicitly refer to Goat, Pig, and Seal. Additionally, the solution contains empty Goat.java, Pig.java, and Seal.java files alongside the Space* implementations. This naming mismatch will confuse students about which class names to implement/use and can break tests or examples that expect Goat/Pig/Seal.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implemented class names match the specification. Either rename SpaceGoat/SpacePig/SpaceSeal to Goat/Pig/Seal and remove or populate the empty Goat.java/Pig.java/Seal.java files, or update the problem statement and UML to reference the Space* class names consistently. Alternatively, provide Goat/Pig/Seal wrapper classes (or have them extend the Space* classes) so the expected class names from the exercise exist and delegate to the existing implementations.
